_comment: M-BRAND-ROUTER test payloads — POST any of the objects in 'scenarios' to the webhook URL. See M-BRAND-ROUTER.spec.md § Test Steps for the full test procedure.

1_sss_webflow_form._description: Happy-path SSS route: simulates a Webflow form submission for She Said Sail. Expect Route 1 to execute, brand_config set to SSS values, HTTP POST to M-LEAD-INTAKE, and audit event logged.

lead_data.message: Looking for a 7-night crewed catamaran charter for a bachelorette trip. Flexible on exact yacht.

2_me_api_submission._description: Happy-path ME route: simulates an API call for Mare Executive. Expect Route 2 to execute, brand_config set to ME values, HTTP POST to M-LEAD-INTAKE (ME), and audit event logged.

lead_data.message: Interested in a luxury motor yacht for a corporate retreat.

3_sss_manual_test._description: Minimal SSS payload: tests that the router works with the bare-minimum required fields. Expect Route 1 to fire and lead_data forwarded as-is.

4_me_staging._description: ME brand staging environment test: verifies environment field is passed through correctly to M-LEAD-INTAKE and M-AUDIT-LOGGER.

5_unknown_brand_edge_case._description: Edge case: brand field is not SSS or ME. Expect neither route to fire. Scenario completes without error and without calling M-LEAD-INTAKE. The audit event (module 7) still fires. No Slack alert expected.

6_sss_production._description: SSS production-environment test: use only after full staging validation. All downstream calls will target live M-LEAD-INTAKE and M-AUDIT-LOGGER. Creates a real record — delete after verifying.

lead_data.message: PRODUCTION SMOKE TEST — delete this record after verification.

curl_example: curl -X POST "https://hook.us1.make.com/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_HOOK_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '<paste one of the scenario objects above>'

expected_outcomes.sss_routes: Route 1 fires. brand_config.brand_name = 'She Said Sail'. Module 4 POSTs to M-LEAD-INTAKE. Module 7 POSTs audit event to M-AUDIT-LOGGER.
expected_outcomes.me_routes: Route 2 fires. brand_config.brand_name = 'Mare Executive'. Module 6 POSTs to M-LEAD-INTAKE. Module 7 POSTs audit event to M-AUDIT-LOGGER.
expected_outcomes.audit_log_field: Airtable Audit Log (tblrMpTfMk8q1eNHp) should gain a record with Scenario_ID='M-BRAND-ROUTER', Event_Type='BRAND_ROUTED', Brand matching the payload.
